           PERTUSSINUM

         Coqueluchin

        (PERTUSSIN)


Taken from the glairy and stringy mucus containing the virus of
        whooping-cough. Introduced by John H. Clarke for the treatment of whooping-cough and other
        spasmodic coughs.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Drosera;
        Corallium; Cuprum; Naphthal; Mephitis; Passiflor; Coccus Cacti; Magnes phos  .



Dose.--  The thirtieth potency.
